title: What the annual energy balance hides: the coordination value of digital platforms for positive energy districts
abstract: arXiv:2611.29485v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Positive energy districts (PEDs) are usually assessed by annual net energy, whereas distribution networks operate hour by hour. An annually positive district still imports on low-generation hours and exports or curtails on high-generation hours. How large this hourly imbalance is behind an annual balance, and how much of it coordination among prosumers can close without new physical capacity, is not established. This paper models a multi-carrier prosumer community coupling electricity and heat behind a shared grid connection with a net-export hosting limit. The model is solved as a centralized community problem and as a price-taking peer-to-peer (P2P) market. Under convexity, the equilibrium implements the regularized community optimum and the P2P and congestion prices are the duals of the pool-clearing and hosting constraints. translated_title: 年度能量平衡所隐藏的问题：数字平台对正能量区域的协调价值
translated_abstract: 正能量区域（PED）通常以年度净能量来评估，而配电网却是按小时运行的。一个年度净值为正的区域，在低发电时段仍需从电网购电，在高发电时段则向外出口或削减发电。这种隐藏在年度平衡背后的逐时不平衡究竟有多大，以及产消者之间的协调能在不新增物理容量的前提下弥补多少，目前尚无定论。本文对一个多能源载体的产消者社区进行建模，该社区在共享电网接入点之后耦合电力与热力系统，并受到净出口承载能力的限制。该模型分别以集中式社区优化问题和价格接受者点对点（P2P）市场两种形式求解。在凸性条件下，市场均衡可实现正则化后的社区最优解，且P2P价格与阻塞价格分别为交易出清约束和承载能力约束的对偶变量。该模型通过构建的逐时能源曲线，校准至六种欧洲街区典型场景。逐时自给……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文揭示年度净能量平衡指标会掩盖正能量区域内部逐时的电力进出口失衡，并通过构建电力-热力耦合的产消者社区集中优化与P2P市场均衡模型，量化证明数字平台协调机制可在不新增物理容量的情况下显著缩小这一失衡。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals how much hourly imbalance lies hidden behind an annual positive energy balance and quantifies, via a coupled electricity-heat prosumer community model and its P2P market equilibrium, how digital platform coordination can close this gap without new physical capacity.
